issues.desc: Checklist items lack userSees fields; each item should state the exact observable output (e.g. probe row text or gate diagnostic message) so DONE verification has a concrete target.

Story type is bug but the work adds new probe fields/gate semantics (feature-shaped hardening); riskSignal auth is real (credential/readiness classification), so normal channel with PLAN decision + preMortem should be followed, not fast-tracked.

No checklist item specifies userSees / concrete user-visible output text (e.g., the exact host-row rendering or gate diagnostic message showing launcher readiness and failureKind), so completion cannot be recognized from observable output alone.

Background/checklist lack an explicit end-state the operator can recognize as done, e.g., a sample probe output showing executionReady=false with failureKind and the corresponding gate explanation; without it users may wonder whether diagnostics are wired end-to-end or only stored as fields.
